units.source_text: 我终于来到你身边住下来了。"

en.t: At last I have come to live here beside you.

units.source_text: 有时我停住拿着扫帚的手，心中南南自语，"

en.t: Sometimes I would stop the hand that held the broom and murmur to myself in my heart,
It does not absolutely have to be now!

units.source_text: 但愿有朝一日你对我显示亲切，对我袒露你的秘密。

en.t: I hope that one day you will show me kindness and reveal your secrets to me.

units.source_text: 你的美，也许再过些时候就会清楚地看见，现在还看不见。

en.t: Perhaps after a little more time I will be able to see your beauty clearly; for now I still cannot see it.

units.source_text: 但愿现实中的金阁比我想像中的金阁会显出更清晰的美。

en.t: I hope the Golden Pavilion in reality will reveal a clearer beauty than the one in my imagination.

units.source_text: 还有，倘使你是人世间无与伦比的美，那么请告诉我，你为什么这样美，为什么必须美？"

en.t: And if you are a beauty without equal in this world, then please tell me: why are you so beautiful, and why must you be beautiful?
